WordPress Rebuild Proposal

On The Spot Accountants — WordPress Rebuild Proposal

Client: On The Spot Accountants — accountancy practice with a regional franchise network
Prepared by: LitOS/LitGroup
Date: August 5, 2026

Rebuild the site on WordPress, replicating its current layout and functionality. Layout suggestions flagged during review are quoted as an optional add-on (Phase 2) so the client can decide whether to include them — if not pursued, those areas are simply replicated as they currently are.

1

Phase 1 — Core WordPress Rebuild (required)

1.1 Platform

Rebuild the site on WordPress, replicating the current layout and functionality.

1.2 Blog / news

Rebuild the blog as a WordPress custom post type, matching the current post layout (e.g. the "Tax Changes From April 2026" post style).

1.3 Partner logos

The "Proudly Part Of" logo strip (IoD, FSB, ICAEW, Enterprise Nation, Sussex Chamber of Commerce) carries over as-is.

1.4 Footer

Rebuild the existing three-column footer (More Information / Registered / Our Shortcuts).

1.5 Social feed

X/Twitter feed section, built with the Custom Twitter Feeds plugin.

1.6 Plugins & theme

Plugins: Contact Form 7, Advanced Custom Fields (ACF), Elementor Pro, Custom Post Type UI, an SMTP plugin, Custom Twitter Feeds.

Recommended additional: Wordfence, Simple CAPTCHA.

Theme: any free theme — the build relies on custom code regardless of which theme is chosen.

1.7 Build approach

Two ways to build the page templates and custom post types:

  • Elementor Pro — paid page builder; gives the most flexibility for the client to edit layouts directly after handover.
  • Elementor (free) + custom-coded archive template and custom post type — no page-builder license cost, but more of the layout logic lives in custom code instead of the builder.
ET65h
Rate$30/hr
Total$1,950

Rate basis: 65h falls in the 20–100h bracket → $30/hr (per standing rate rules). Elementor Pro's license (1.7), if that build approach is chosen, is a separate cost not included above.

2

Phase 2 — Layout Improvements (optional)

Covers the layout suggestions flagged during review. Effort is additional to Phase 1 and not yet estimated — to be quoted once the client confirms which of these to include.

Navigation

The site currently runs two near-identical menus side by side. Consolidate these into a single menu, and replace the "Login" text link with an account icon.

Header

Fix the responsive header: on smaller screens it currently breaks apart instead of collapsing cleanly, with the phone numbers, email, and logo stacking awkwardly instead of resolving into a compact sticky bar.

Hero section

Simplify the hero to the "On The Spot Accountants" brand line only. The "Why Us? / Client Case Studies / Become a Franchisee" links currently overlaid on the hero image move into their own section below it, separate from the hero.
